title: Residue logarithmic cotangent quotient and finite characteristic cokernel
statement: Let $f:(X,M)\to(Y,N)$ be log smooth between locally Noetherian fs log schemes [def-trf-fs-log-blowup, def-per-fs-log-smooth-etale]. Fix a geometric point $\bar x$ over $\bar y$ and a chart $Q\to N$ with $Q$ sharp fs. Put $A=\mathcal O_{X,\bar x}$, $k=A/\mathfrak m_A$, $C=\overline M_{\bar x}^{\rm gp}$, and $D=C/\operatorname{im}(Q^{\rm gp})$; geometric stalks are as in [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. The relative logarithmic differential module $\omega_f$ is generated over $\mathcal O_X$ by $du$ for regular functions and $d\log m$ for log sections, with additivity, the Leibniz rule, $d\log(mm^{\prime})=d\log m+d\log m^{\prime}$, $d\alpha(m)=\alpha(m)d\log m$, and vanishing of $du$ and $d\log m$ for sections pulled back from the base. There is a surjection $$\pi:k\otimes_A\omega_{f,\bar x}\longrightarrow k\otimes_{\mathbf Z}D$$ taking $1\otimes d\log t$ to $1\otimes[t]$ and $1\otimes du$ to zero. There exist finitely many $t_1,\ldots,t_r\in M_{\bar x}^{\rm gp}$ whose classes $1\otimes[t_i]$ form a $k$-basis of $k\otimes_{\mathbf Z}D$. For any such choice, $C/(\sum_i\mathbf Z[t_i]+\operatorname{im}Q^{\rm gp})$ is finite, killed by some positive integer $n$ invertible in $A$. For every positive integer $a$ invertible in $A$, the group $A^\times$ is $a$-divisible, meaning each of its elements is an $a$th power of a unit. The empty basis is allowed.
